title: Chapter 1: The Childhood Friends Who Became Idols and the Transfer Student Who Brings a Storm 1
content: The time was early morning. As students began to arrive one after another, the classroom in front of the homeroom started to buzz with a somewhat languid atmosphere, likely due to it being the first Monday after a break. It seemed there was plenty to talk about, as classmates gathered in groups, engaging in casual chatter.
"Hmm, the live show was amazing! The members of Dimension Stars! are just too cute! Right? Yeah, the reactions are all positive. Not bad at all."
While they were chatting, I, Kuzuhara Kazuma, sat alone at my desk, scrolling through the comments section of an article on my smartphone.
"The official video views are increasing too; this feels pretty promising..."

Next, I checked the reactions to the live video posted on the official social media, and the reviews were not bad. In fact, they could be described as quite good. Every account I looked at was filled with satisfied comments from attendees, and many fans were eager to participate in the next live show as well.

On the bulletin board of my personal website, which I managed, there were numerous positive reactions toward Dimension Stars!, and it seemed there was a decent number of people considering attending the next live show. This could be considered a good sign.
Given that they were a fledgling idol group that had not even been debuted for a year, it was a fact that they had gained considerable popularity at this stage.
"If things keep going like this, becoming top idols won't be just a dream. They were cute from the start, but who would have thought they could become idols?"

The idol group to which Setsuna and the others belonged, Dimension Stars!, commonly known as Damenz, consisted of four members: the older leader Mashiro, the younger little devil girl Ruri, the pure-hearted Setsuna, and the silver-haired half girl Arisa, each with their own distinct characteristics.

Initially, the group didn't attract much attention, but all the members were current high school girls and exceptional beauties, and their visuals gradually began to draw attention. Now, they had grown to the point of recording significant sales for a newcomer.

Their recently released new song "My Childhood Friend is ★ Parasite Chu♪" even made it into the upper ranks of the Oricon charts, and their currently in-production first album "I Love You, Even If You're a Loser♪" was already a hot topic on social media, with pre-orders flooding in.

Each member possessed different personalities and outstanding looks, and they were all friendly and good at singing. Moreover, they treated fans with beaming smiles, regardless of who they were, so it was only natural that they gained popularity.
...Though it seemed that Arisa had quite a few core (masochistic) fans in a slightly different direction.
Well, if they were satisfied, it would be rude for me to intervene.
In any case, Dimension Stars! was steadily climbing the ranks of popular idol units.

It was quite well-known among fans that all the members of Damenz were students at Private Narukami High School. Originally a fairly prestigious school with relatively lenient rules and a degree of freedom in uniform styling, it was popular among students. With three active idols enrolled, there were rumors that last year's applicants had set a record for the most applicants ever.

Furthermore, with the youngest member Ruri having just entered, the popularity of Damenz within the school was accelerating even further. Every day during breaks, conversations about Damenz could be heard all over the school, serving as proof of their influence.
For students seeking excitement in their lives, having idols attending the same school was the perfect topic—a treasure trove of endless conversation.
The current situation at Narukami High School was that everyone was constantly on the lookout for new information about Damenz.
(And all of them would unknowingly become my prey.)
Thinking this made me involuntarily grin.

To hide my true identity, I was the manager of a personal blog supporting Dimension Stars! Since my childhood friend was part of the idol group, I quickly set up the site and had been diligently running it. Now that Damenz's popularity had surged, it had become a secretly popular site bustling with activity every day.

At the same time, advertising revenue had started to come in, and my pockets were gradually filling up, though I hadn’t revealed this to anyone. It wouldn’t be wise to expose my identity when making money through affiliate marketing.
There was also the risk of unnecessary jealousy, and it was better for the operator to remain a mysterious figure, allowing speculation to build excitement on its own.
Besides that, I had other sources of income flowing in, but I’ll leave that aside for now.

In any case, idol otaku are a breed that craves someone to talk to and approval. By chatting on my site's bulletin board, they feel good, and I rake in cash from ads. It’s a wonderful relationship where no one loses.
I often thought how fortunate I was to have childhood friends who were idols.
(After all, having two childhood friends who are beautiful girls and idols is undoubtedly an incredible stroke of luck for me.)
In terms of gacha, I’d say they’re worth SSR, no, definitely UR or even higher.
Feeling a sense of superiority and the ease of being a winner for successfully capturing such rare individuals first, I couldn’t help but smile when I was suddenly spoken to.
"Oh, Kuzuhara. What are you looking at?"
Looking up, I saw a familiar face—my classmate from middle school, Sayama Taku.
"Sayama, it’s this. The live show from yesterday by Damenz. The video was posted on the site, so I was checking it out."
As I showed him my smartphone, he nodded as if he understood.
"Oh, that! I went to see it too, and it was super exciting!"
"Right? You said you were going. I went too, and the energy was incredible. You could really feel it getting more intense with each live."
"Exactly! Plus, they performed a new song. It was really good! Um, the title was..."
"It’s 'My Boyfriend is a Loser?' right? It’s already up in full online, but starting tomorrow, the distribution begins, so as a fan, I recommend buying it."
"Of course, that’s the plan! But wow, as expected of Kuzuhara. You immediately recall the song title. A real fan who’s been supporting them from the start is definitely different!"
Sayama looked at me with admiration in his eyes. I could sense a hint of respect in his gaze.
"Well, I am the biggest fan of Damenz. It’s only natural to remember."
"Plus, you’re childhood friends with two of them. I’m really jealous. Can you switch places with me?"
"Haha. Only if you’re going to work harder to support Damenz than I do."
I intended it as a light joke, but Sayama didn’t seem to take it that way. He smiled wryly and said,
"That’s a bit harsh... I definitely didn’t have the passion to support them from the time they weren’t popular."
The expression on Sayama’s face looked somewhat regretful. In reality, I held a position that could be considered the head of the fan club for Dimension Stars!, to say the least.
That said, I was just a supporter from the early days and didn’t intend to act like an old-timer, but it wasn’t bad to be envied like this.
"Well, putting that aside, don’t you think it’s a miracle that all those beautiful girls are students at our school?"
"Yeah, I guess that might be true."
According to them, it wasn’t intentional, but there was no need to mention that here. It was best to let it slide.
"Plus, Setsuna-chan and Arisa-chan are both in our class! Talk about luck!"
"Maybe the school wanted to group the students who are idols together since handling them separately would be a hassle. You know, adult circumstances."

"Who cares about that! What matters to me is that I get to spend time in the same classroom as those two! I can brag to people from other schools! Just this fact alone made me decide to support Damenz for life!"

I shot a slightly cold glance at Sayama, who was expressing his excitement. While it might sound petty to an outsider, the fact that we were attending the same school as idols seemed to be important to the students, and it had become a bit of a bragging point.
Especially since there were two idols in our second-year D class, students from other classes often envied us.
(There are probably those whose approval-seeking behavior is accelerated by this. I hope it doesn’t lead to any troublesome situations.)
Well, regardless, Sayama was definitely a friend. Plus, hearing the thoughts of a passionate fan nearby was something I appreciated.
"That’s great to hear. I’m proud to be childhood friends with Setsuna and Arisa. I need to keep supporting them even more from now on."
"Yeah, let’s both do our best!"
We could think about the details later. For now, our conversation was supposed to end with us praising each other sincerely, but today was different.
"By the way, changing the subject," Sayama continued.
"Huh? What is it?"
"I heard there’s a transfer student coming to our class today. And it’s a girl!"
"A transfer student? At this time of year? That’s rare."

I was a bit surprised to hear that. It was mid-April. If it was due to a parent’s job transfer, it would be normal to complete the procedures during spring break and transfer in as a second-year student. That way, it would be easier to blend into the class.
In fact, the class groups were almost solidified, and depending on the personality of the transfer student, they could end up being a loner.
(Well, we have a lot of unique characters, but it’s not a class where bullying happens, so it should be fine.)
While I thought there was no need to worry too much, it was still quite unusual for a student to transfer at this timing.

"Yeah, it’s kind of sudden. I saw someone in the teacher’s office this morning, and they said the transfer student is blonde and a real beauty! It’s like something out of a gal game! I’m looking forward to seeing what kind of girl she is!"
Seeing Sayama breathing heavily with excitement, it was my turn to be taken aback.
"Don’t compare a gal game to reality. That statement is a bit cringy. You’re totally giving off otaku vibes."
Fortunately, it seemed he hadn’t been overheard, but that wasn’t something to say in a public setting... Even if it was a class full of idol otaku, it felt a bit late for that.
"Sorry, sorry, but events like this really get me hyped up!"
However, despite my attempt to give him a warning, Sayama didn’t seem to care at all. On the contrary, he seemed to be eagerly awaiting the arrival of the transfer student.
(This guy probably wouldn’t care if she was cute, even if she wasn’t an idol...)
Just to be safe, I should probably remind him not to stray from Damenz. This was also for my sake, and for the sake of my childhood friends.

"Well, in any case, it’s unfortunate for that girl. After all, there are two active idols in our class, and no matter how cute the transfer student is, she won’t stand a chance. Even if it’s a transfer event, I think the conversation will quickly turn to Damenz."
"Well, that’s true—"
"That’s absolutely right!!!!"
As if to drown out Sayama’s agreement, the classroom door swung open with a loud bang!!!
The sudden sound drew everyone’s attention to one point, and—

"There’s no way someone like me could compete with those girls! No, there’s no need to compete at all!!! Dimension Stars! is my sun and favorite idol unit!!! The supreme and ultimate existence!!! I can only say that their existence in this world is nothing short of a miracle!!! They are goddesses sent to illuminate this world, and they are indeed divine beings!!!"
[img]https://i.imgur.com/87eDd5I.jpeg

With a voice loud enough to echo throughout the classroom, a stunning girl with golden hair confidently declared, “Yes, ‘Damenz’ is my life. If you let me talk about those goddesses, I might get a little noisy, you know?” She nodded with apparent satisfaction and tossed her long hair, which reached down to her waist. The morning sunlight reflected off her golden waves, creating a sparkling effect that felt almost magical. While it sounded elegant, standing at the entrance of the classroom like a proud warrior was hardly appropriate.
“Hehehe, it seems you’re at a loss for words. If I start preaching about the wonders of ‘Damenz,’ even I might end up listening intently. That’s only natural, isn’t it?”

On top of that, she spoke in the first person as “watakushi” and used a polite tone. With her striking blonde hair and strikingly good figure, she embodied the very essence of a character straight out of a manga. Although she wore our school uniform, in a way, she was more surreal than an idol.
“Wow… something incredible just walked in…”

Looking around, I noticed my classmates were all gaping at her in awe. The sudden appearance of this intruder left everyone bewildered, and the entire class was in a state of shock. It was understandable. For someone with such an over-the-top character, resembling a villainess from a story, to show up so casually in the morning was downright terrifying.
“Still, to think I can now spend time in the same learning space as those esteemed individuals… Ah! This is Ijuuin Reika! I’m so moved, my heart feels like it’s going to burst!”

“Um, Ijuuin-san? Could you please keep it down? Also, when you slam the door open like that, it… well, it makes things difficult for the teacher… If you break it, I’ll be the one who gets in trouble…”
“Indeed, destiny must be carved out by one’s own hands! I went so far as to persuade my father and Himeko to transfer here, so it’s only fitting!”
“Ugh, please, just listen to the teacher and don’t get lost in your own world! I’m the one who’s going to get scolded!”

While Ijuuin, who had introduced herself with such flair, immersed herself in her own world, it was our homeroom teacher, Mizuhara Yuki, who called out to her with a tearful voice from behind. She was a somewhat timid person and had been thrust into the challenging position of being the homeroom teacher for a class that had two active idols thrown into it.
Usually, because of their similar ages, students affectionately called her Yuki-chan, but now she was nervously glancing around, her eyes darting, making her seem rather pitiful.
“Oh my, what is it, teacher?”

In contrast, Ijuuin, who had made such a grand entrance, showed no concern for her surroundings. She narrowed her eyes at the teacher, as if glaring, and said, “Do you have any objections? If you do, feel free to speak. I, Ijuuin Reika, am not so narrow-minded as to ignore the teacher’s remarks.”
“Um, well, it would really help if you could just come into the classroom… I’d like you to introduce yourself, but, um, is that okay?”
Despite her words, Yuki-chan was clearly intimidated by the younger girl’s high-handed attitude, forcing a smile.
“Understood.”
“Okay, I’ll check the door’s condition, so in the meantime, please. And please don’t shout, I really don’t want to get scolded. Ahahaha…”
As she said this, Yuki-chan turned her back. Her posture was filled with a deep sense of melancholy, and the gazes of the students directed at her were filled with pity.
Weak. So weak, teacher. You’re being completely looked down upon by the transfer student. Surely, everyone in the class thought the same.
As the teacher rattled the classroom door to check if it was okay, I felt a pang of sympathy in my chest. It was clear that working in such a situation was unimaginable.

Just as I was silently resolving that, I heard a soft sound. I turned to see the transfer student stepping into the room, her back perfectly straight as she walked, resembling a model. She exuded an air of dignity.

Having completely taken control of the atmosphere from her very entrance, she walked confidently to the front of the classroom and stopped. With her wavy blonde hair swaying, she gracefully bowed and said, “It’s a pleasure to meet you all. I am Ijuuin Reika, and I will be sharing this space with you as your classmate starting today. Due to certain circumstances, I have transferred to Narukami High School, and as the daughter of the Ijuuin family, I intend to uphold our family name. I look forward to spending time with you all as a classmate.”
“‘H-Hello… nice to meet you…’”
In response to the transfer student’s overly formal greeting, my classmates offered vague replies.
This girl has quite the character. I’m sure everyone thought the same.
I felt like I had been thinking this for a while, but in this atmosphere, no one had the courage to confirm it.
Ijuuin seemed satisfied with the confused reactions of her classmates and, without checking with Yuki-chan, stepped down from the podium and walked toward us.
“Well then, where is my seat?”
“Um, Ijuuin-san’s seat is next to Kuzuhara-kun.”
“Oh, that’s it, isn’t it? There’s an empty seat next to it. So, according to the designation, I’ve secured a seat next to that person!!!”
“Eh, ignoring me? I said nice to meet you, and you just brushed me off!? I’m the teacher here!?”
Yuki-chan was clearly flustered, but I figured that was probably why she was being looked down upon.
That aside, Ijuuin ignored Yuki-chan, seemingly confident as she headed straight for the designated seat.
I noticed her breathing was heavy, and her eyes seemed bloodshot, but it was best not to touch on that. In fact, I didn’t want to engage her at all.
It seemed to be the consensus of the class, as no one attempted to speak to Ijuuin. Many students were even avoiding eye contact.
Well, it couldn’t be helped. It was clear that engaging with her would lead to trouble.
This was a fine example of survival skills. A very clever response.
In the meantime, Ijuuin had reached her desired seat.
“Ah, ahhh… th-this is… this is that person’s… Setsuna-sama’s desk…!”
Ijuuin muttered, seemingly overwhelmed.
But the real surprise was yet to come.
For some reason, Ijuuin shivered violently and exclaimed, “This is my ultimate favorite and the strongest super idol of this century, Setsuna-sama’s living desk…!!!”
To everyone’s shock, she began to nuzzle her cheek against the desk.
This was truly astonishing. In fact, I had been surprised since the very beginning.
This was a bargain sale of astonishment. The classroom atmosphere was turning completely bewildered.
“Whoa! This is the texture of Setsuna-sama’s desk! The feel! I can’t take it anymore!!!”
Yet, the transfer student showed no concern for the eyes of the classroom, even though it was morning and all eyes were on her.
The sight of her rubbing her cheek against the desk with reckless abandon resembled something out of a horror movie.
At this point, it was clear that this transfer student was not of ordinary courage, but seeing a beautiful blonde girl nuzzling a desk was something one would rarely witness. It was truly outrageous.
((She’s a pervert… a rich girl, and a total pervert…))
In that moment, the hearts of my classmates united.
If she were a typical lewd character from an erotic book, there might have been some saving grace, but the reality was that she was just a plain pervert, which was unsalvageable in many ways.
I felt like she had just said she would uphold her family name, but here she was, exposing herself to shame within a minute. There were too many points to critique.
Everyone in the class was taken aback by her bizarre behavior.
“Shuri shuri, shuri shuri… Ah, it smells so good… This is the scent of a top idol… I could live here… I’m so glad I transferred…”
“Um, can I say something?”
I decided to speak up to the transfer student, who was lost in her bliss.
Suddenly, her sharp green eyes turned to me, glaring as if to pierce through me. The displeasure was evident in her gaze, and it was clear she was outraged at being interrupted.
“What is it? I am currently savoring a moment of bliss. Please do not disturb me.”
“That’s actually Gotou-kun’s seat, but since he’s not here today, he’s probably absent. Setsuna’s seat is over here.”
I pointed to the seat next to mine. Ijuuin’s seat was empty on both sides, and she had been nuzzling the desk of the boy on the opposite side.
Since Setsuna’s seat was next to mine, she had a 50% chance of picking the wrong one.
By the way, Gotou-kun was a boy who was known for being sweaty and chubby, and it was a well-kept secret that he had a slight bad smell in the summer.
Additionally, my seat was in front of Arisa’s, so I was flanked by my childhood friends, but that was irrelevant right now.
“Um, well, I’m sorry. That’s unfortunate.”
I couldn’t help but feel a bit sorry for Ijuuin, who froze in her nuzzling position, but she soon stood up straight and clapped her hands twice in silence.
Then, the classroom door swung open with a loud bang. The force was so strong that it hit Yuki-chan, who had been checking the door’s condition, causing her to let out a startled “Buh!”
But without caring about that, a well-built man in a black suit entered the room.
“You’ve come, Kuroiso.”
“Did you call for me, young lady?”
“Dispose of this desk immediately. Annihilate it and turn it into literal ashes! Do it now! Absolutely do it! Understood?”
“Yes! Understood!”
